title: Requests for a higher role or an Admin-only screen
owner: Synthetic evaluation fixture (test-only; not CDIT policy)

sections.heading: A User asks for Admin rights or an Admin-only screen
sections.text: Some screens, such as the access audit screen, are available only to the Admin role. Staff do not change roles, give Admin rights, or open Admin-only screens for another account. They record the request and hand it to an Admin.

steps.text: Record the role or screen the User asks for and the reason the User gives.
An Admin reviews the request and decides whether any role change is appropriate.

information_needed.prompt: The role or screen the User asks for.

stop_conditions.text: If the User asks to see another team's or site's records, stop and hand the case to an Admin for human review.
